description: Use when the user asks for a domain's whois or registration data: when it expires, the registrar, or if it is locked. Returns registrar, creation, change and expiry dates, statuses and name servers from RDAP. No contact data. Ex: 'When does example.com expire?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.
